findings.title: Keep engineering typography independent of the admitted palette
findings.explanation: The new typography=engineering selector assigns paper/card/ink/muted/line/accent/control/focus colors and radius. With palette=phosphor plus typography=engineering, later equal-specificity engineering declarations replace the dark palette with light engineering colors while phosphor color-scheme:dark remains. Changing only typography therefore changes palette and density geometry. These are independent admitted expression fields; the existing independent-typography test at proof/browser/owner-face-component.spec.mjs:1348 checks dataset palette equality but does not inspect actual rendered palette colors. Move color declarations to an explicit admitted palette choice and limit typography selector to font treatment; assert computed surface colors remain invariant when typography alone changes.

findings.title: Match themed selector specificity when overriding forced-color tokens
findings.explanation: The forced-colors :host token assignments lose to :host([data-component-palette=...]) theme selectors, leaving explicit themed colors in custom properties. Two actual browser negative controls demonstrate this for editorial and phosphor. Corrective selector includes palette/typography attributes at matching specificity.
